title: Mulukhiyah Pasta
subtitle: fresh green pasta with chilli tomato butter
description: Homemade green pasta coloured with mulukhiyah (jute) leaves, tossed with cherry tomatoes, garlic, chilli and butter and served with grated labneh-style cheese.

steps.text: Blend 70 g mulukhiyah leaves and the water in a food processor to a puree.
Add the flours, eggs, salt and 2 tbsp olive oil to the food processor and pulse for a few seconds to a crumbly dough.
Transfer to a work surface and knead by hand until the dough is firm and uniform. Form a ball, wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for half an hour.
Divide the dough into 5 pieces and roll each through a pasta machine to a sheet about 1 mm thick.
Cut the dough into fettuccine with the pasta machine cutter. If you don't have one, flour the dough, roll up into a log and slice into thin ribbons.
Boil salted water and cook the pasta for about 3 minutes. Drain, keeping 1/2 cup of the cooking water.

Make the sauce: heat a dry frying pan over medium heat and toast a few coriander seeds for a few seconds until fragrant. Add 2 tbsp olive oil and fry the sliced garlic and chilli for about 30 seconds. Add the quartered cherry tomatoes and fry until soft and breaking down.
Add the cooked pasta and a handful of whole mulukhiyah leaves and stir for about 1 minute while frying.
Place the diced butter on top, season with salt and pepper and cook only until the butter melts into the sauce. Grate hard yoghurt cheese over the pasta and serve immediately.
